name: Mutton Broth
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: cold water per pound of meat
ingredients.originalText: One quart of cold water per pound of meat

ingredients.name: stick of celery per quart of stock
ingredients.originalText: One stick of celery per quart of stock

ingredients.name: rice per quart of stock
ingredients.originalText: Two tablespoonfuls of rice per quart of stock

instructions.text: Cut the meat into pieces and remove the fat
To each pound of meat add one quart of cold water
Simmer for four or five hours
Strain it into an earthen bowl
When ready to serve, remove the grease, and add to each quart of stock one stick of celery, two tablespoonfuls of rice, salt and pepper to taste
Boil until the rice is soft

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cut the meat into pieces and remove the fat
2. To each pound of meat add one quart of cold water
3. Simmer for four or five hours
4. Strain it into an earthen bowl
5. When ready to serve, remove the grease, and add to each quart of stock one stick of celery, two tablespoonfuls of rice, salt and pepper to taste
6. Boil until the rice is soft
originalIngredients: One quart of cold water per pound of meat
One stick of celery per quart of stock
Two tablespoonfuls of rice per quart of stock
